description: Convert a JSON sample into TypeScript interfaces and types. Objects become named interfaces (PascalCase from their key), nested objects get their own interfaces, arrays become element-type arrays with keys merged across all elements (keys missing from some elements are marked optional), and null values are folded into unions such as string | null. Empty arrays become unknown[] and empty objects become Record<string, unknown>. Runs on Hopi's server; nothing is stored. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/json-to-typescript/

json.description: A JSON sample to convert. It may be an object, an array or a primitive value.

rootName.description: Name for the root interface or type alias (default Root).

name: hopi_json_to_typescript

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)
